title: Homogeneous self-dual interior-point method for linear programming
abstract: Formalizes a homogeneous self-dual interior-point method for linear programming, including primal-dual data, Newton block solvability from full row rank, fixed Ye-Todd-Mizuno predictor/corrector local estimates, contraction bounds, and logarithmic stopping certificates for generated iterates.

informal.HSDInteriorPointLP.YTM_fixed_local_theor: Packages the fixed Ye-Todd-Mizuno local theory, combining predictor and corrector estimates for the tight and wide central neighborhoods.
informal.HSDInteriorPointLP.HSDGeneratedAlgorithm: Proves that the generated even iterate satisfies the gap stopping test at the logarithmic pair bound.
Proves that the generated even iterate satisfies the duality-measure stopping test at the scaled logarithmic pair bound.
informal.HSDInteriorPointLP.HLP_newton_block_syst: Shows solvability of the Newton block system from the full-row-rank assumption through finite-dimensional linear algebra.
informal.HSDInteriorPointLP.YTM_contraction_power: Bounds the fixed YTM contraction power by the corresponding exponential decay estimate.
